revised_solution:
1. Agree definitions in a workshop chaired by the CFO, with the CFO deciding any definition the department heads can't agree on.
2. Build a data store, funded from this year's analytics budget and released in two phases with a go/no-go gate.
3. Rebuild board reports.
4. Retire the old departmental spreadsheets on a set date, after which the new reports are the only ones used in the monthly review.
